papers.title: Multi-Step Bayesian Optimization for One-Dimensional Feasibility Determination
papers.abstract: Bayesian optimization methods allocate limited sampling budgets to maximize expensive-to-evaluate functions. One-step-lookahead policies are often used, but computing optimal multi-step-lookahead policies remains a challenge. We consider a specialized Bayesian optimization problem: finding the superlevel set of an expensive one-dimensional function, with a Markov process prior. We compute the Bayes-optimal sampling policy efficiently, and characterize the suboptimality of one-step lookahead. Our numerical experiments demonstrate that the one-step lookahead policy is close to optimal in this problem, performing within 98% of optimal in the experimental settings considered.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化方法虽涉及采样效率，但局限于一维可行性判定问题，与用户关注的生物力学FEA代理建模或植入物优化无关。
llm.why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no constraint handling beyond feasibility, no high-dimensional or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 计算一维昂贵函数可行域的高效多步贝叶斯优化策略
summary_zh.method: 基于马尔可夫过程先验，计算贝叶斯最优采样策略
summary_zh.result: 一步超前策略在实验设定下达到最优性能的98%
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验对比一步与多步策略的亚优性

summary_en.motivation: To compute efficient multi-step lookahead policies for determining superlevel sets of expensive one-dimensional functions.
summary_en.method: Derives the Bayes-optimal sampling policy using a Markov process prior and characterizes the suboptimality of one-step lookahead.
summary_en.result: One-step lookahead achieves near-optimal performance (within 98%) in the tested settings.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments demonstrate the efficiency and optimality gap of the proposed policy.

papers.title: Stream-based Online Active Learning in a Contextual Multi-Armed Bandit Framework
papers.abstract: We study the stream-based online active learning in a contextual multi-armed bandit framework. In this framework, the reward depends on both the arm and the context. In a stream-based active learning setting, obtaining the ground truth of the reward is costly, and the conventional contextual multi-armed bandit algorithm fails to achieve a sublinear regret due to this cost. Hence, the algorithm needs to determine whether or not to request the ground truth of the reward at current time slot. In our framework, we consider a stream-based active learning setting in which a query request for the ground truth is sent to the annotator, together with some prior information of the ground truth. Depending on the accuracy of the prior information, the query cost varies. Our algorithm mainly carries out two operations: the refinement of the context and arm spaces and the selection of actions. In our algorithm, the partitions of the context space and the arm space are maintained for a certain time slots, and then become finer as more information about the rewards accumulates. We use a strategic way to select the arms and to request the ground truth of the reward, aiming to maximize the total reward. llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究上下文多臂老虎机中的主动学习，与有限元代理建模或植入物设计完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, does not handle constraints or uncertainty quantification, and is not transferable to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决上下文多臂老虎机中获取奖励真值成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出流式在线主动学习算法，维护上下文和动作空间划分并策略性选择查询
summary_zh.result: 算法遗憾为次线性，与无查询成本的传统算法同阶
summary_zh.validation: 理论证明无需实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the high cost of obtaining ground-truth rewards in contextual multi-armed bandits.
summary_en.method: A stream-based online active learning algorithm that maintains partitions of context and arm spaces and strategically selects queries.
summary_en.result: The regret is sublinear and of the same order as conventional algorithms without query cost.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis only, no experimental validation.

papers.title: MICROSTRUCTURE AND MECHANICAL PROPERTIES OF HEAT TREATED SELECTIVE LASER MELTING MANUFACTURED TI-6AL-4V

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM Ti-6Al-4V的热处理与力学性能，但未涉及生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或表面形貌等核心方向。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration in a biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对SLM Ti-6Al-4V显微组织和力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 对SLM成形的Ti-6Al-4V进行不同热处理，并进行微观表征与力学测试
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著改变了显微组织和力学性能，如强度和延展性
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试（如拉伸、硬度）验证了热处理效果

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Heat treatments were applied to SLM Ti-6Al-4V samples, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly altered the microstructure, leading to changes in strength and ductility.
summary_en.validation: Experimental tensile and hardness tests validated the mechanical property changes.
